title: King's Game: Origin
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Thirty years before the main King's Game story, a black envelope arrives in remote Yonaki Village carrying 'the King's' orders, and failure to obey is punished (Crunchyroll blurb via AniList, MangaUpdates). A reviewer describes a 1977 village of 32 people forced through sadistic, mostly fatal trials by an unseen dictator, with several murders (Otaku USA). It is a prequel manga based on a novel.
life_message: Little is held up as good: the story mainly shows people breaking under an arbitrary, deadly command.

content.note: Trials 'most of them fatal' and several murders, with 'oblique framing' on the goriest moments (Otaku USA); Blood and Gore, Game of Death (MangaUpdates).
Survival horror with characters killed off often (Otaku USA; Crunchyroll blurb); Death Game, Tragedy (AniList).
Reviewer: 'prurient or scandalous, though rarely in any substantial way'; Forbidden Love, Seduction (MangaUpdates); AniList spoiler tag Incest (to verify).
AniList spoiler tag Suicide only; review does not mention it. Capped (to verify).
Chain-message 'orders' game premise; villagers turn on each other (AniList, review).
Part of a larger King's Game franchise.

folkways.japan: Reflects Japanese fears of the closed rural village (mura shakai) where group pressure overrides the individual.

delivery.note: The series is built around suspense and deaths rather than any stated message.
